fullContentHtml:
UPCISB Cooperative Bank Various Posts Exam Date 2026 – Full Details

U.P. Co-operative Institutional Service Board (UPCISB) has released the Exam Date for the various posts. This recruitment was released for 2085 posts. Applications for the UPCISB UP Cooperative Bank Various Post Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 25 April 2026 to 15 May 2026. The examination is going to conducted on 14 – 26 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can Check their UPCISB UP Cooperative Bank Various Post Exam Date 2026 from the link given below

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 25 April 2026
  • Last Date : 15 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 15 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 17-21 September 2026
  • Exam Date Remaining Posts : 14 – 26 October 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • For UR, OBC : Rs 500/-
  • For SC/ST : Rs. 250/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Important Links

  • Check Exam Date Notice (Remaining Posts)
  • Download Admit Card
  • Download Exam Date Notice
  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification (Hindi)
  • Download Notification (English)
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPCISB Cooperative Bank Various Posts Exam Date 2026?

UPCISB Cooperative Bank Various Posts Exam Date 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
